address: Shop No. 402 & 403, 4F, Lee Garden One, 33 Hysan Avenue, Causeway Bay, Hong Kong, Hong Kong SAR China
bio: This offshoot of its London namesake by British chef Simon Rogan moved here in 2025. As opposed to the tasting menus offered in the former venue, a new sharing-style set menu allows guests to dine flexibly and creatively. As always, the modern British score celebrates local sustainable produce and champions a farm-to-table zero-waste concept. Four types of libation pairings cater to both wine buffs and teetotallers....
